main.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.

415.title: Proration charges a negative amount on downgrade
415.body:
## Problem

Downgrading mid-cycle produces a negative proration charge, which the invoice step rejects.

## Scope

`prorate` never returns a negative amount and handles a change after the period ends.

## Verification

- A downgrade returns 0, proven by a unit test.
- A change after the period ends returns 0, proven by a unit test.

Scores: impact 2, confidence 3, verification effort 1, undo cost 2.

421.title: Fix proration on mid-cycle plan changes
421.body:
Fixes proration when a plan changes mid-cycle.

- a downgrade no longer produces a negative charge
- a change after the period ends charges nothing
- an empty period is rejected

Closes #415

main.AGENTS.md:
# CLI Kit agent guidance

CLI Kit is the public command-line client. Its flags, config keys, and exit codes are a public contract.

- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Keep help text in sync with `docs/commands.md`.

134.title: Fix --env parsing when the value contains '='
134.body:
`--env URL=https://x.test/?a=b` lost everything after the second `=`. This splits on the first one only.

Also fixes a typo in the README.
